summary: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a private offering of $750 million 6.125% senior notes due 2034, issued by its subsidiary FirstCash, Inc. and guaranteed by the parent and domestic subsidiaries. The notes were sold under Rule 144A/Regulation S via Jefferies LLC. No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
